Actual focused source/integration controls completed with registered argv/cwd/PID/integer status/nonempty unchanged guards and raw stdout/stderr

finite_groups.operation: Authenticate actual stable integration source/preimage identities and already-executed source-preparation/focused-test receipts; check registration, actual PID, integer completion, stdout/stderr refs and nonempty equal guards. Do not run workflow predicates or repeat unchanged candidate controls.

Mechanically compare bootstrap source inventory/snapshot and native binding deltas to actual baselines. Ensure registered JS/reader/generator/launcher dependencies are frozen and copied; declared own-session runtime outputs are excluded. Compact author selection is explicit; every unrelated function/source constant and legacy API remains exact outside declared deltas.

Review independent versioned reconstruction/profile and integration bridge: authenticate actual generator, reader, runtime and registered dependency bindings before reconstruction; source-derive literal/AST template/message bytes without importing/calling the producer generator for expected reconstruction. Descriptor identity is externally frozen-registry/template trust, not arbitrary caller repinning publisher authentication.

Check compact selection for native/fresh unrelated fixture author and associated source bindings only. Preserve legacy main/PURE collector recipes and exact27 semantic success predicates, marker order/original roots/totals/both EOF requirements, literal FINAL, no deadline/resampling and no transport-derived proof/admission/lifecycle claims.

Compare focused test source to declared delta requirements and actual control evidence. Preserve concrete failures and corrections; use existing controls for unchanged behavior without inherited runtime PASS. Output only bounded source-integration observations and concrete binding/semantic counterexamples.

prohibited: Premature review PASS from unfinished draft
Old protocol disguised as unchanged compact mode
New workflow gates or success predicate changes beyond explicit source transport binding revision
